name: Persee 2
summary: Persee 2 combines stereo RGB-D sensing with an Amlogic A311D AI computer. It supplies depth and color streams with onboard processing and standard network interfaces for embedded perception and application development. Orbbec includes the exact camera in its robotics vision catalog; end of marketing is scheduled for December 2026.

sources.quote:
EOL Announcement for Persee 2
Dear customers:
In order to better assist you in addressing market changes and the challenges of
technological innovation, Orbbec Optical has provided the key lifecycle milestone
points for the Persee 2 . We hope this information will serve as a reference for your
future product planning and development.
Orbbec Inc.
June 10,2026
Milestone Date Remark
EOL announcement 2026-06-10 EOL publicity date
EOM 2026-12-30
End of Marketing. The EOM date is the date
when the product stops accepting orders,
including orders for new sites and capacity
expansion. After that date, the product will no
longer be sold.
EOS 2028-12-30
End of Service & Support. It refers to the last
date of the service. After the EOS date, Orbbec
does not provide any service for the product.
Including software and hardware problem
support and update.
Replacement product
End of Life product Replacement product
Persee 2 Gemini 2L/335L/336L +customer-owned
development board (e.g. Raspberry Pi 5)
